scope: Authorized read-only live Supabase review; project identity/status, catalog-only permissions/RLS/functions/FKs/extensions, migration history and one security advisor call. No business/user rows, user emails, sessions, key retrieval, config blobs, mutation, provider calls or tests.

source_migration_comparison.matched_schema_family: Live public tables, own-user policies, RPCs and key ownership FKs correspond to the committed Oct13 consolidation baseline.
source_migration_comparison.mismatch: The committed baseline filename timestamp differs from the actual applied migration version, and older September/October migrations are not recorded in this live target. The committed directory is not one replayable linear history for this target.
source_migration_comparison.source_replay_observation: September migration creates agentnexos_demo_requests; Oct13 consolidation rejects any existing agentnexos table (TARGET_NOT_EMPTY). This is a source/history maintenance issue, not evidence that live DB is broken.
source_migration_comparison.next_step: Reconcile authoritative baseline and migration history non-destructively before M5; no repair was attempted.

notices.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
notices.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
notices.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`public.agentnexos_demo_limits\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`public.agentnexos_demo_requests\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

security_advisors.interpretation: Only two INFO RLS-enabled/no-policy notices on demo_limits and demo_requests. Both tables have no effective anon/authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE grants; service-only deny-all access is deliberate, so these notices do not establish exposure. Do not add public policies merely to clear the advisor.

confirmed_controls: All five public tables have RLS enabled.
anon has no effective SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on any public table.
authenticated can SELECT/DELETE its own conversations, SELECT its own messages, and INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE its own profile, bounded by auth.uid ownership policies.
Profile UPDATE has both USING and WITH CHECK; a composite conversation_id,user_id FK binds message ownership to conversation ownership.
Both demo tables deny all checked operations to anon/authenticated; public RPCs deny EXECUTE to both roles.
All five public RPCs use invoker privileges with an empty search_path.
auth.users exists with RLS and denies SELECT to anon/authenticated. No auth-user records were read.
Live reservation function retains advisory locking, rolling 24-hour limits and request-triggered 48-hour deletion.

confirmed_gaps.title: Retention remains request-triggered
confirmed_gaps.evidence: Live reserve_agentnexos_demo_v3 contains the 48-hour DELETE; pg_cron extension is absent and cron.job does not exist.
confirmed_gaps.impact: Database-side scheduled cleanup is not configured. External schedulers were not inspected here; root handles Vercel/source context.

confirmed_gaps.title: Source and live migration history diverge
confirmed_gaps.evidence: Live records one Oct13 consolidation at a version different from the committed file; older committed migrations are absent from target history.
confirmed_gaps.impact: Future migration/recovery work needs a reconciled baseline before assuming sequential replay.

not_verified: Real account creation, mailbox delivery, confirmation, signin, recovery, session refresh and logout roundtrip.
Counts, identities, emails, membership or business data of actual users; these were intentionally not queried.
Auth provider settings, MFA, email templates, redirect allowlist, SMTP, password policies, leaked-password protection or auth rate limits; secret-containing config endpoints were not read.
Actual TTL effectiveness and oldest row age; no data rows were inspected or deleted.
Cross-user runtime behavior through authenticated API clients; catalog policies were inspected without executing user sessions.
Backups/PITR/restore rehearsal, storage buckets, customer integrations, organization/tenant runtime or paid plan capabilities.
External Vercel cron or other scheduler; absence of database cron alone does not rule out an external scheduler.
claim_boundaries: Live database catalog verifies current RLS and grant configuration, not end-to-end tenant/customer authorization.
auth.users access denial is evidence of table protection, not proof of a functioning login/email flow.
The app's public assistant remains independent of login and does not persist raw chats through the active API.
Enterprise routes remain disabled in source; database schema does not establish connected execution.
